# Nolan's Knives

> Handmade knives, past builds, and custom knife requests from Nolan's Knives in Huntsville, Alabama.

Nolan's Knives is based in Huntsville, Alabama. The public site shows available knives, past work, the custom request process, and customer contact options.

## Public pages

- [Handmade Knives in Huntsville, AL | Nolan's Knives](https://nolansknives.com/): Explore available handmade knives, past builds, and custom knife requests from Nolan's Knives, a self-taught bladesmith based in Huntsville, Alabama.

- [Request a Custom Knife | Nolan's Knives](https://nolansknives.com/custom-knife-request): Submit a custom knife request to Nolan with your intended use, design preferences, materials, budget, timing, and delivery preference for review.
- [About Nolan's Knives | Huntsville, Alabama](https://nolansknives.com/about): Learn about Nolan, a self-taught bladesmith in Huntsville, Alabama, and how custom requests, quotes, deposits, build updates, and delivery work.
- [Contact Nolan's Knives | Huntsville, Alabama](https://nolansknives.com/contact): Contact Nolan's Knives about available knives, custom requests, or an existing order. Customers can also sign in for messages and order updates.

## Important factual notes

- Location: Huntsville, Alabama, United States.
- Custom projects begin with a request and quote; accepted custom builds use a 15% deposit before work is scheduled.
- Account, checkout, customer order, and business workspace pages are private workflow pages and are not intended for search indexing.
